from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u035/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and row[0] == 2 and all(v == 2 for v in row)]
    if not bars:
        return out
    divider = bars[0]
    if divider == 0 or divider == h - 1:
        return out
    top_color = grid[0][0]
    if top_color == 0 or any(v != top_color for v in grid[0]):
        return out
    bottom_rows = [r for r in range(divider + 1, h) if any(v != 0 for v in grid[r])]
    if not bottom_rows:
        return out
    bottom = grid[bottom_rows[-1]]
    for c in range(w):
        if bottom[c] == top_color:
            for r in range(1, divider):
                if grid[r][c] == 0:
                    out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
